transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net mobile technical support. My name is David. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello David. I really need help with my phone number. I transferred my mobile number from Vodafone to S-Net yesterday with a PAC code. Outgoing calls work fine, but whenever anyone tries to call me from another network like EE or Vodafone, they get a recorded message saying my number is not recognized!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can certainly look into that for you. That sounds like a split-routing issue where the central porting tables haven't updated across all UK networks. Before we access your account records and run routing tests, can I take your date of birth and your account reference number, please?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, my date of birth is the 14th of August 1988, and my account reference is SN-884219.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you very much. I have your account pulled up on my system here. Can you confirm the mobile number you ported across?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It is 07700 900381. I run a freelance design consultancy from home, so this is causing massive issues.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, so the mobile number is 07700 900381.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, exactly. I have clients trying to reach me all morning for urgent project approvals, and they think my business has closed down because the line says invalid number! I'm losing potential contracts as we speak, it's so frustrating and stressful!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I completely understand how stressful and frustrating that is when your business clients cannot reach you and it impacts your work. Please rest assured, I am going to take full personal ownership of this issue right now and get your incoming routing properly resolved.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you, I appreciate that.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: To help diagnose the exact routing breakdown across the national networks, could you tell me roughly what time yesterday your Vodafone SIM lost service?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It lost service around 11:30 in the morning yesterday. Then I put the S-Net SIM in, and by 2 PM I got a text saying port completed.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Understood. When you make an outgoing call from your handset right now, what number displays on the recipient's phone?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: When I call my partner, it shows my correct ported number, 07700 900381. And we both hear each other perfectly.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And when people try to call you and get the invalid number message, do you know what mobile networks those callers are on?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, one client is on Vodafone and another is on EE. Both of them got the recorded message saying the number is not recognized or not in service.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That confirms it. That is a textbook split-port or incomplete routing broadcast in the national Mobile Number Portability clearinghouse.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Could it be a physical issue with the SIM card itself?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: No, because outgoing calls work and display your correct number, the SIM card hardware is functioning perfectly.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What does that actually mean in practice?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: When a telephone number ports, the donor network, Vodafone in this case, must update the central database to tell all other UK networks to direct inbound traffic to S-Net. If their routing sync file failed to populate across all transit gateways, calls originating from other networks still look for Vodafone's switches.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Right, I see. Can you fix that from your side or do I have to ring Vodafone?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You do not need to call Vodafone at all. I can submit an expedited manual MNPO routing broadcast directly from our network operations console right now, which forces all carrier gateway tables to refresh.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Oh, that is such a relief. Thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Bear with me for a couple of minutes while I open the clearinghouse gateway tool and push the manual broadcast update for your number.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Sure, I will hold on.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for holding. I have accessed the central MNPO portal and re-sent the routing announcement broadcast for 07700 900381.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Has it gone through already?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, the status flag has just updated to active on the national routing ledger across all major transit points.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That was very quick.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now what we need to do is refresh your phone's connection to our local mast so that the SIM re-registers with the updated HLR profile.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Do I need to turn the phone completely off, or just airplane mode?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Since we are speaking on this line right now, are you calling me on the mobile handset with the ported SIM?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, I am actually calling you from my home landline specifically so that we could troubleshoot the mobile without disconnecting.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That is ideal! That makes testing very straightforward. Please go into your mobile phone's settings and toggle Airplane Mode on for ten seconds, then toggle it back off.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, toggling Airplane Mode on now... waiting ten seconds... and toggling it back off. The S-Net 5G icon is back on.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great. Now I am going to initiate a test incoming call to your mobile number from our external PSTN test simulator to verify external routing.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, the phone is right beside me on the desk.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: One moment while I route the test call through an external carrier loop.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Sure.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for your patience. I have just triggered the external inbound call. Is your mobile handset ringing?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes! It is ringing right now! The screen shows Incoming Call from an 020 London number!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Please go ahead and answer it, and say hello into the handset.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello? Yes, I hear the automated test tone crystal clear through the earpiece!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Excellent. You can end that test call now. That proves the inbound routing through external networks is completely restored.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Oh, that is fantastic! That has saved me so much hassle. I can already see two voicemail notifications popping up from missed calls earlier.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That is great news. Are all your services, text messages and mobile data working properly as well?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, mobile data has been great, and texts have just come through without any problem. Everything is working normally now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Do you travel often for your freelance consulting work?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, I travel to Dublin quite often. Will this number still work smoothly when I am roaming?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, EU roaming uses the same refreshed clearinghouse record, so your handset will connect seamlessly.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is brilliant news, thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am so glad we could get that sorted out for you today. Is there anything else on your account or mobile service I can assist you with?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, that was the only problem and it is completely resolved now. Thank you so much for your help.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It was my absolute pleasure. Thank you for choosing S-Net. Have a wonderful rest of your day.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you, David. You too.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Take care and goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net. Goodbye.
